event.text: I cannot advise you to support or oppose the proposed 2027 budget. Supporting it helps fund goals like building 3,500 affordable homes by 2029 [1]. The Region also aims to cut community emissions by 50% by 2030 [2, 3]. However, the Region faces an infrastructure funding gap (money short for repairs). That gap is $87.6 million each year [4]. Without federal transit funding, that yearly gap grows by another $17.5 million [5].
